title: CellCanon: An Agentic Cellular World Model for Prediction, Explanation, and Observation-Driven Updating
title_zh: CellCanon：用于预测、解释和观察驱动更新的智能体细胞世界模型

paragraphs.en: Biological discovery requires using molecular knowledge and new measurements to infer responses beyond the conditions already observed. We introduce CellCanon, the first agentic cellular world model to unify single-cell expression prediction, evidence-grounded explanation, and observation-driven updating. Its predictive core reuses condition-level biological evidence across gene-specific numerical readouts to guide single-cell expression generation. A shared world state links predictions, acquired measurements, and source-linked claims, supporting explanation and revision. On 339 held-out SciPlex3 conditions across three cell lines, CellCanon improves differential-expression AUPRC and Macro-F1 over the best baseline for each metric by 63.3% and 17.3%, respectively, and direction Macro-F1 by 7.2%. Relative to gene-wise reasoning on matched drug–cell cohorts, measured language-model token use falls by 99.77% for Predict and 98.41% for Explain. On the source-grounded benchmark, Explain correctly answers all answerable questions with supporting proofs and identifies all insufficient-evidence cases. In simulated experimental feedback, Update uses one measured source context per drug to exceed the best fine-tuned baselines in differential-expression AUPRC and Macro-F1 without changing model weights. Together, these capabilities support a cumulative account of cellular responses, with predictions and biological judgments that can be revised as evidence accumulates.
paragraphs.zh: 生物学发现需要利用分子知识和新的测量来推断超出已观察条件的响应。 我们提出 CellCanon，首个智能体式细胞世界模型，统一单细胞表达预测、有证据支撑的解释和观测驱动的更新。 其预测核心跨基因特异性数值读数复用条件级生物学证据，以引导单细胞表达生成。 一个共享的世界状态将预测、获取的测量和带来源出处的论断链接起来，支持解释与修正。 在三个细胞系的 339 个保留 SciPlex3 条件上，CellCanon 在差异表达 AUPRC 和 Macro-F1 上分别超过各指标最佳基线 63.3% 和 17.3%，方向 Macro-F1 超过 7.2%。 相对于在匹配的药物–细胞队列上逐基因推理，Predict 的语言模型 token 用量下降 99.77%，Explain 下降 98.41%。 在以来源为依据的基准上，Explain 以支撑性证明正确回答所有可回答的问题，并识别出所有证据不足的情形。 在模拟实验反馈中，Update 对每种药物仅使用一个测量来源上下文，即在不改变模型权重的情况下在差异表达 AUPRC 和 Macro-F1 上超越最佳微调基线。 这些能力共同支持对细胞响应的累积性刻画，其预测和生物学判断可随证据积累而修订。

paragraphs.en: Single-cell perturbation screens reveal drug-induced transcriptional changes but leave many compounds and cell contexts unmeasured ( Srivatsan et al., 2020 ; Bunne et al., 2024 ) . A cellular world model must combine molecular knowledge and new measurements to predict unobserved responses while keeping biological judgments inspectable and revisable.
paragraphs.zh: 单细胞扰动筛选揭示了药物诱导的转录变化，但仍有许多化合物和细胞情境未被测量（Srivatsan et al., 2020；Bunne et al., 2024）。 细胞世界模型必须结合分子知识与新的测量来预测未观测到的响应，同时保持生物学判断可检验且可修正。

paragraphs.en: Numerical perturbation models efficiently predict expression profiles ( Lotfollahi et al., 2023 ; Hetzel et al., 2022 ; Piran et al., 2024 ; Qi et al., 2024 ) . Gene-wise language reasoning combines molecular knowledge and retrieved examples to infer response labels ( Wei et al., 2026 ) . Genes in one drug–cell condition share biological background but require distinct response estimates. We reuse this evidence interpretation across gene-specific numerical readouts, with distinct supervision for continuous response, differential expression (DE), and conditional direction (DIR).
paragraphs.zh: 数值扰动模型能够高效地预测表达谱（Lotfollahi et al., 2023；Hetzel et al., 2022；Piran et al., 2024；Qi et al., 2024）。 基因级语言推理结合分子知识与检索到的样例来推断响应标签（Wei et al., 2026）。 同一药物–细胞条件下的基因共享相同的生物学背景，但需要各自不同的响应估计。 我们在基因特异的数值读出之间复用这种证据解释，并对连续响应、差异表达（DE）和条件方向（DIR）采用不同的监督。

paragraphs.en: We introduce CellCanon, the first agentic cellular world model to unify single-cell expression prediction, evidence-grounded explanation, and observation-driven updating. Encoded molecular evidence and a training-response atlas feed continuous multilayer perceptron (MLP) and classification readouts, whose gene-specific outputs guide single-cell generation ( Figure 2 ). A shared world state links these predictions to source-linked claims and acquired measurements; observation-conditioned maps update response estimates ( Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 CellCanon，这是首个智能体化细胞世界模型，可统一单细胞表达预测、基于证据的解释以及观测驱动的更新。 编码的分子证据与训练响应图谱输入连续多层感知机（MLP）和分类读出模块，其基因特异性输出用于指导单细胞生成（图2）。 共享的世界状态将这些预测与带来源链接的论断及获取的测量结果联系起来；以观测为条件的图谱更新响应估计（图1）。

paragraphs.en: Update uses a measured response to revise predictions for the same drug in other, still-unmeasured cell contexts. We evaluate this process by progressively revealing existing SciPlex3 measurements to simulate experimental feedback. Separate observation-state tasks assess how measurement availability changes support for biological claims.

Optimal transport models shifts between cell distributions ( Bunne et al., 2023 ; Driessen et al., 2026 ) . LGR aggregates measured responses from LLM-selected neighboring drugs ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) ; MapPFN supports in-context genetic-perturbation prediction without gradient updates ( Sextro et al., 2026 ) . Evaluations emphasize target and protocol choices ( Ahlmann-Eltze et al., 2025 ; Viñas Torné et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: ChemCrow connects language models to chemistry tools; BioDiscoveryAgent designs genetic perturbation experiments ( Bran et al., 2024 ; Roohani et al., 2025 ) . PerturbAgent organizes perturbation analysis and prediction, while VCWorld studies language-based virtual-cell reasoning ( Pei et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) . PerTurboAgent updates phenotype predictions and prioritizes experiments from accumulated Perturb-seq observations ( Hao et al., 2025 ) . BaiZe predicts expression and supports few-shot cross-species adaptation; BaiZe-Agent retrieves and explains saved results ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . CellCanon links prediction, source-grounded explanation, and measurement-driven revision through a shared world state.
paragraphs.zh: ChemCrow 将语言模型与化学工具相连接；BioDiscoveryAgent 设计基因扰动实验（Bran et al., 2024；Roohani et al., 2025）。 PerturbAgent 组织扰动分析与预测，而 VCWorld 研究基于语言的虚拟细胞推理（Pei et al., 2026；Wei et al., 2026）。 PerTurboAgent 根据积累的 Perturb-seq 观测数据更新表型预测并对实验进行优先级排序（Hao et al., 2025）。 BaiZe 预测表达并支持少样本跨物种适应；BaiZe-Agent 检索并解释已保存的结果（Zeng et al., 2026）。 CellCanon 通过共享的世界状态将预测、有依据来源的解释以及由测量驱动的修正联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Explain assesses source support for target action, control-cell expression, regulatory paths, and source statements, returning supported , contradicted , or insufficient evidence judgments with citations and natural-language rationales. Control-cell expression supplies cellular context; functional and binding records characterize drug–target interactions. Candidate drug–target–regulatory paths retain evidence types and edge signs. Tools enumerate unknown-sign assignments consistently across shared edges, and the language model selects eligible paths.

paragraphs.en: Update uses a newly measured drug response to revise predictions for the same drug in unmeasured cell contexts. The environment reveals a selected source condition’s response and DE/DIR labels. A support-trained kernel ridge model combines measured source-response similarity with chemical and biological similarities to infer the target response ( Equations 12 and 13 ). The parent predictor and update maps remain fixed. One or two source-cell responses can be used; without a source measurement, the initial prediction is retained.
paragraphs.zh: 更新步骤利用新测得的药物响应来修正同一药物在未测量细胞情境下的预测。 环境揭示一个被选定的源条件的响应以及 DE/DIR 标签。 一个经过支持集训练的核岭回归模型将测得的源-响应相似性与化学和生物学相似性相结合，以推断目标响应（公式 12 和 13）。 父预测器和更新映射保持不变。 可以使用一个或两个源细胞响应；若没有源测量值，则保留初始预测。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 339 held-out SciPlex3 conditions in A549, K562, and MCF7 ( Srivatsan et al., 2020 ) , pooling 24-hour responses across doses. Continuous scores cover 2,000 genes; classification retains all reference DE positives and randomly samples up to 200 negatives with unadjusted p > 0.1 p>0.1 per condition ( Appendix A ). We use the DeepSeek-V4-Flash API for evidence compilation and frozen Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B embeddings ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .

The first four use validation-fitted DE adapters and validation-selected decision rules. Squidiff, PerturbNet, and STATE generate cell populations, from which differential testing against matched DMSO yields DE and direction predictions ( Appendix C ). VCWorld uses DeepSeek-V4-Flash.

paragraphs.en: Continuous-response metrics include Top50 mean-expression R 2 , logFC Pearson, and Δ \Delta -Pearson for changes relative to DMSO; within-condition scores are averaged across test conditions. Top50/Top100 panels follow absolute reference Wilcoxon ranks. DE and DIR use AUPRC, AUROC, Macro-F1, accuracy, precision, and recall. DIR conditions on reference-DE queries with up-regulation as positive. Joint unchanged/up/down evaluation includes detection and direction errors ( Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 连续响应指标包括 Top50 平均表达 R 2、logFC Pearson 以及相对于 DMSO 变化的 Δ \Delta-Pearson；条件内分数在测试条件上取平均。 Top50/Top100 面板遵循绝对参考 Wilcoxon 排名。 DE 和 DIR 使用 AUPRC、AUROC、Macro-F1、准确率、精确率和召回率。 DIR 以来自参考 DE 的查询为条件，以上调为正类。 联合的未变/上调/下调评估包括检测错误和方向错误（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: We simulate experimental feedback by revealing existing SciPlex3 measurements under fixed acquisition schedules. Each of three partitions withholds one target cell context per test drug; the other two supply measurements. One observation reveals a drug–cell response at 24 hours across all four doses. CellCanon is evaluated with and without Update under identical schedules and budgets. Feedback scores use condition-level response and classification readouts, averaged across partitions. Six response models are fine-tuned on revealed source-cell populations at 48 observations and one source context per drug. Target conditions remain unobserved ( Appendices G and H.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过在固定的采集计划下揭示已有的 SciPlex3 测量数据来模拟实验反馈。 三个分区中的每一个都对每种测试药物保留一个目标细胞情境；另外两个分区则提供测量数据。 每次观测揭示一种药物–细胞在 24 小时下横跨全部四个剂量的响应。 CellCanon 在相同的计划与预算下分别在启用与不启用 Update 的情况下进行评估。 反馈评分使用条件级别的响应与分类读出，并在各分区上取平均。 六个响应模型在每种药物揭示 48 个观测和一个源细胞情境的源细胞群体上进行微调。 目标情境保持未被观测（附录 G 与 H.1）。

paragraphs.en: CellCanon connects accurate single-cell response prediction, source-grounded explanation, and observation-driven updating in an agentic cellular world model. Shared evidence supports gene-specific readouts and generation with substantially lower language-model token use. The world state links predictions to the evidence and observations needed to check and revise them. In simulated experimental feedback, measured responses improve predictions for unobserved cell contexts of the same drug.

paragraphs.en: After continuous training, the encoder is frozen and regularized logistic heads are fitted on its representations. For support size n n , the DE prior is ( n c ​ g D ​ E + 0.5 ) / ( n + 1 ) (n_{cg}^{DE}+0.5)/(n+1) ; the up prior is ( n c ​ g up + 0.5 ) / ( n c ​ g D ​ E + 1 ) (n_{cg}^{\mathrm{up}}+0.5)/(n_{cg}^{DE}+1) . Their logits initialize the offsets. The objective combines DE binary cross-entropy over all support coordinates and direction binary cross-entropy over support DE coordinates, with an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} penalty on coefficients and intercepts. For hard DE decisions, we enumerate validation probability thresholds and select the threshold with the highest Macro-F1 on the sampled validation queries, keeping expression predictions and adapter coefficients fixed. Selected thresholds are 0.038410 for BioLORD, 0.028758 for chemCPA, 0.041701 for CMonge, and 0.047620 for PRnet. BioLORD and CMonge use fitted direction scores. For chemCPA and PRnet, validation Macro-F1 selects between the fitted direction adapter and the native signed-logFC readout; both select signed logFC, with positive values classified as up. This rule is fixed before test scoring. PRnet uses stochastic generation from its predicted expression distribution.

paragraphs.en: The CMonge adaptation uses a two-layer 512-unit autoencoder with a 100-dimensional latent space. We train it for 100 complete epochs (71,600 updates), selecting the checkpoint by validation reconstruction MSE. A conditional transport map uses RDKit descriptors, log dose, and cell-line indicators and trains for 500,000 updates. Checkpoint selection every 10,000 updates uses mean-expression R 2 over 228 validation drug–cell–dose conditions, with negative condition scores floored at zero for this selection criterion. The selected map is the 10,000-update checkpoint. At inference, matched DMSO cells are encoded, transported, decoded, and clipped to nonnegative expression; aggregation produces the pooled condition response. The test output contains 341,202 cells by 2,000 genes. All reported test R 2 values retain negative scores. On the sampled endpoint, CMonge’s DE precision/recall are 0.3432/0.7334 and accuracy is 0.7402; conditional DIR accuracy is 0.6700.
paragraphs.zh: CMonge 适配采用一个两层、512 单元的自编码器，潜空间维度为 100。 我们对其训练 100 个完整 epoch（71,600 次更新），并依据验证集重构 MSE 选择检查点。 条件传输映射使用 RDKit 描述符、对数剂量和细胞系指示变量，并训练 500,000 次更新。 检查点每 10,000 次更新选择一次，依据是在 228 个验证药物–细胞–剂量条件上的平均表达 R 2，且在该选择标准下负的条件得分被下限截断为零。 选定的映射是 10,000 次更新时的检查点。 在推理时，对匹配的 DMSO 细胞进行编码、传输、解码并截断为非负表达；聚合后得到池化的条件响应。 测试输出包含 341,202 个细胞和 2,000 个基因。 所有报告的测试 R 2 值均保留负分。 在采样的终点上，CMonge 的 DE 精确率/召回率为 0.3432/0.7334，准确率为 0.7402；条件 DIR 准确率为 0.6700。

paragraphs.en: PerturbNet [ Yu et al., 2025 ] uses the pretrained 196-dimensional ChemicalVAE representation, a 10-dimensional scVI cell latent, and a conditional invertible network with 20 coupling blocks and hidden width 1,024. Molecular features, cell-line indicators, and log dose condition the flow. We train scVI for 700 epochs and the flow for 100 epochs, both with batch size 128; validation ELBO and population-expression MSE select epochs 695 and 80, respectively. Decoded counts use paired panel and full-library sizes sampled from training cells matched by cell line and dose, then transform to log1p CP10K. Molecular canonicalization and equivalent SMILES enumeration supply the chemical encoder inputs.
paragraphs.zh: PerturbNet [Yu et al., 2025] 使用预训练的 196 维 ChemicalVAE 表示、10 维的 scVI 细胞潜在变量，以及一个包含 20 个耦合块、隐藏层宽度为 1,024 的条件可逆网络。 分子特征、细胞系指标和对数剂量作为该流的条件输入。 我们训练 scVI 700 个 epoch，训练该流 100 个 epoch，两者的批大小均为 128；通过验证集上的 ELBO 和群体表达 MSE 分别选择第 695 和第 80 个 epoch。 解码的计数使用按细胞系和剂量匹配、并从训练细胞中采样的成对 panel 库大小和全库大小，然后转换为 log1p CP10K。 分子规范化与等价 SMILES 枚举为化学编码器提供输入。

paragraphs.en: We train the STATE transition model [ Adduri et al., 2025 ] from scratch with its eight-layer, 768-hidden-unit, 12-head bidirectional transformer and energy distribution loss. Its continuous perturbation input concatenates a 2,048-bit radius-2 Morgan fingerprint with normalized log dose. Matched DMSO cells form the input; each condition-homogeneous set contains 128 cells. Training uses batches of 96 sets, Adam at 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and BF16 network computation with FP32 loss calculation. Early stopping ends training at epoch 540, and validation energy selects epoch 390.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从零开始训练 STATE 状态转移模型 [ Adduri et al., 2025 ]，该模型采用八层、768 隐藏单元、12 头的双向 Transformer 以及能量分布损失。 其连续扰动输入将 2,048 位、半径为 2 的 Morgan 指纹与归一化的对数剂量拼接在一起。 以匹配的 DMSO 细胞作为输入；每个条件同质的细胞集合包含 128 个细胞。 训练使用大小为 96 个集合的批次，Adam 优化器学习率为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，网络计算采用 BF16，损失计算采用 FP32。 早停在第 540 个 epoch 结束训练，并依据验证能量选择第 390 个 epoch。

paragraphs.en: Random independently samples a Bernoulli ( 0.5 ) (0.5) label for each query, using the same binary value as its ranking score and hard decision. DE uses all 55,598 sampled test queries; DIR uses the 8,651 reference-DE queries, independently of the random DE decisions. For each of 100 seeds (0–99), separate task-specific random streams draw uniform values and threshold them at 0.5. We compute each metric on the complete query set within each seed and report its mean across all seeds. Tied binary scores are retained. Table 7 gives the standard deviations across random draws. For joint evaluation, the DE decision first selects unchanged versus changed, and the independent direction decision splits changed predictions into up and down. The resulting class probabilities are 0.5, 0.25, and 0.25, respectively. Joint Macro-F1 is 0.2881 ± 0.0018 0.2881\pm 0.0018 and accuracy is 0.4607 ± 0.0019 0.4607\pm 0.0019 , where the standard deviations describe variation over the 100 random seeds. This reference produces classification outputs only.

sents.zh: 在 top-100 基因面板上，它达到 0.3971/0.3809，相比之下 chemCPA 为 0.3888/0.3632（表 9）。

paragraphs.en: These ablations score the shared condition predictor before probability-guided generation. All variants use the 54-support/19-validation/113-test identifier split and the same 2,000-gene evaluation. Input interventions retrain the affected frontend and independent heads, select settings on validation drugs, and average three seeds. Readout-only interventions keep continuous predictions fixed and fit their decision rules on validation drugs. Validation selects hidden width, weight decay, and DE/DIR regularization using the same search protocol across variants. Knowledge projection and normalization use the 162 support conditions. The DE count decoder is refitted on the 57 validation conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些消融实验在概率引导生成之前对共享的条件预测器进行评分。 所有变体均使用 54 支持/19 验证/113 测试的标识符划分，以及相同的 2,000 基因评估。 输入干预会重新训练受影响的前端和独立的头，在验证药物上选择设置，并对三个随机种子取平均。 仅读取干预保持连续预测不变，并在验证药物上拟合其决策规则。 验证过程在各变体中使用相同的搜索协议来选择隐藏层宽度、权重衰减以及 DE/DIR 正则化。 知识投影和归一化使用 162 个支持条件。 DE 计数解码器在 57 个验证条件上重新拟合。

sents.en: These ablations score the shared condition predictor before probability-guided generation.
sents.zh: 这些消融实验在概率引导生成之前对共享的条件预测器进行评分。

sents.en: All variants use the 54-support/19-validation/113-test identifier split and the same 2,000-gene evaluation.
sents.zh: 所有变体均使用 54 支持/19 验证/113 测试的标识符划分，以及相同的 2,000 基因评估。

sents.en: Input interventions retrain the affected frontend and independent heads, select settings on validation drugs, and average three seeds.
sents.zh: 输入干预会重新训练受影响的前端和独立的头，在验证药物上选择设置，并对三个随机种子取平均。

sents.en: Readout-only interventions keep continuous predictions fixed and fit their decision rules on validation drugs.
sents.zh: 仅读取干预保持连续预测不变，并在验证药物上拟合其决策规则。

sents.en: Validation selects hidden width, weight decay, and DE/DIR regularization using the same search protocol across variants.
sents.zh: 验证过程在各变体中使用相同的搜索协议来选择隐藏层宽度、权重衰减以及 DE/DIR 正则化。

sents.en: Knowledge projection and normalization use the 162 support conditions.
sents.zh: 知识投影和归一化使用 162 个支持条件。

sents.en: The DE count decoder is refitted on the 57 validation conditions.
sents.zh: DE 计数解码器在 57 个验证条件上重新拟合。

paragraphs.en: The knowledge-removed variant sets all 96-dimensional query/key knowledge inputs to zero throughout training and removes target and mechanism-of-action priors. Removed information includes text embeddings, target/pathway/action annotations, LLM judgments, and target-conditioned DMSO features. Chemical similarity, support-response values, ordinary training statistics, and cell-specific modules remain. This intervention measures the contribution of the combined biological-annotation channel.
paragraphs.zh: 去除知识变体在整个训练过程中将所有 96 维的 query/key 知识输入置零，并移除靶点与作用机制先验。 被移除的信息包括文本嵌入、靶点/通路/作用注释、LLM 判断以及以靶点为条件的 DMSO 特征。 化学相似性、支持-响应值、普通训练统计量以及细胞特异性模块均予以保留。 该干预措施衡量了组合生物学注释通道的贡献。

sents.en: The knowledge-removed variant sets all 96-dimensional query/key knowledge inputs to zero throughout training and removes target and mechanism-of-action priors.
sents.zh: 去除知识变体在整个训练过程中将所有 96 维的 query/key 知识输入置零，并移除靶点与作用机制先验。

sents.zh: 化学相似性、支持-响应值、普通训练统计量以及细胞特异性模块均予以保留。

sents.en: This intervention measures the contribution of the combined biological-annotation channel.
sents.zh: 该干预措施衡量了组合生物学注释通道的贡献。

paragraphs.en: The text-removed variant retains LLM target selection, relevance, scope, and structured fields, but removes evidence-text and target-description embeddings. Its structured vectorization and 96-dimensional projection are refitted on training conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 去除文本的变体保留了 LLM 的目标选择、相关性、范围和结构化字段，但移除了证据文本和目标描述的嵌入。 其结构化向量化和 96 维投影在训练条件上重新拟合。

sents.en: The text-removed variant retains LLM target selection, relevance, scope, and structured fields, but removes evidence-text and target-description embeddings.
sents.zh: 去除文本的变体保留了 LLM 的目标选择、相关性、范围和结构化字段，但移除了证据文本和目标描述的嵌入。

sents.en: Its structured vectorization and 96-dimensional projection are refitted on training conditions.
sents.zh: 其结构化向量化和 96 维投影在训练条件上重新拟合。

paragraphs.en: Measured-context removal deletes target control-expression and detection fields before compiling evidence for every condition, excludes those fields and their missingness indicators from text and structured features, and removes detection-based target weights. The response atlas is retained. Query features and atlas knowledge keys use the context-free encoding; training response values remain available. Drug/gene annotations, cell identity, and ordinary training means and scales remain. Context-free compilation introduces generation variation alongside context removal.
paragraphs.zh: 度量上下文移除在为每个条件编译证据之前，删除目标控制表达式和检测字段，从文本和结构化特征中排除这些字段及其缺失指示符，并移除基于检测的目标权重。 响应图谱予以保留。 查询特征和图谱知识键使用无上下文编码；训练响应值仍然可用。 药物/基因注释、细胞身份以及常规训练均值和尺度均保留。 无上下文编译在上下文移除之外引入了生成变异。

paragraphs.en: Biological-annotation deletion produces the largest classification losses among these input interventions. Table 11 reports their ranking and hard-decision metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些输入干预中，删除生物学注释造成的分类损失最大。 表11报告了它们的排名与硬决策指标。

sents.en: Table 11 reports their ranking and hard-decision metrics.
sents.zh: 表11报告了它们的排名与硬决策指标。

paragraphs.en: With the response atlas retained, removing measured background reduces delta Pearson and Spearman on all 2,000 genes and the top-20/50/100 reference panels ( Table 12 ). All-gene Pearson decreases by 0.0265 and Spearman by 0.0091; the top-100 decreases are 0.0241 and 0.0293. All eight paired difference intervals exclude zero. Direction mAP also decreases from 0.9135 to 0.9093. The classification operating points in Table 11 show that the benefit is endpoint-specific: DE F1 is 0.8118 without measured context versus 0.8077 for the complete model.
paragraphs.zh: 在保留响应图谱的情况下，去除实测背景会降低全部 2,000 个基因以及 top-20/50/100 参考集上的 delta Pearson 和 Spearman 相关系数（表 12）。 全基因 Pearson 下降 0.0265，Spearman 下降 0.0091；top-100 的降幅分别为 0.0241 和 0.0293。 全部八个配对差值区间均不包含零。 方向 mAP 也从 0.9135 降至 0.9093。 表 11 中的分类操作点表明该收益依赖于终点：不含实测上下文时 DE F1 为 0.8118，而完整模型为 0.8077。

sents.zh: 表 11 中的分类操作点表明该收益依赖于终点：不含实测上下文时 DE F1 为 0.8118，而完整模型为 0.8077。

paragraphs.en: The first readout variant refits the DE count decoder on validation predictions. A second variant replaces that decoder with fixed DE thresholds selected separately for each cell line to maximize sampled-validation Macro-F1. paragraphs.zh: 第一种读出变体在验证集预测上重新拟合 DE 计数解码器。 第二种变体将该解码器替换为针对每个细胞系单独选择、以最大化抽样验证 Macro-F1 的固定 DE 阈值。 两者都在真正的 DE 查询上使用验证集选定的方向阈值，并保留分数并列。 表 13 的所有行共享相同的连续响应。

sents.en: The first readout variant refits the DE count decoder on validation predictions.
sents.zh: 第一种读出变体在验证集预测上重新拟合 DE 计数解码器。

paragraphs.en: Independent heads achieve DE AUPRC 0.8588 versus 0.1429 for magnitude-based scores. Their DE Macro-F1 is 0.8077, compared with 0.4538 using the refitted count decoder and 0.5278 using fixed thresholds. Joint three-state Macro-F1 is 0.7242 versus 0.3029 and 0.4361, respectively. Direction remains more recoverable from the signed response, with Macro-F1 0.8134 versus 0.8393 for the independent direction head. These comparisons support task-specific classification readouts over direct magnitude/sign decisions from the same mean-response predictor.
paragraphs.zh: 独立头实现的差分表达 AUPRC 为 0.8588，而基于幅值的得分为 0.1429。 它们的差分表达 Macro-F1 为 0.8077，而使用重拟合的计数解码器为 0.4538，使用固定阈值为 0.5278。 联合三态 Macro-F1 为 0.7242，而两者分别为 0.3029 和 0.4361。 从带符号响应中方向仍然更可恢复，Macro-F1 为 0.8134，而独立方向头为 0.8393。 这些比较支持使用任务特定的分类读出，而不是从同一个平均响应预测器直接做出幅值/符号决策。

paragraphs.en: We use 1,000 paired bootstrap draws over 112 canonical drug identities, keeping aliases and all associated cells and genes in the same block. Table 14 reports variant-minus-reference differences. The five principal classification intervals for annotation removal exclude zero. Context removal with the atlas retained reduces direction mAP, and replacing the independent readouts reduces DE AP, DE F1, and DIR F1; their reported intervals also exclude zero. Delta-context intervals appear alongside all four reference panels in Table 12 . Text embeddings give a smaller direction-ranking effect. These exploratory intervals are conditional on the selected ensembles and use no multiple-comparison adjustment.

paragraphs.en: The raw-source knowledge view gives DE AP 0.8661 and direction mAP 0.9065; LLM compilation gives 0.8588 and 0.9135, respectively. Compilation therefore improves direction ranking by 0.70 percentage points while trading off DE ranking and a small amount of continuous error. The two knowledge views differ in source volume.
paragraphs.zh: 原始来源知识视图给出 DE AP 0.8661 和方向 mAP 0.9065；LLM 编译分别给出 0.8588 和 0.9135。 因此，编译以牺牲 DE 排名和少量连续误差为代价，将方向排名提升了 0.70 个百分点。 这两个知识视图在来源体量上有所不同。

sents.zh: 原始来源知识视图给出 DE AP 0.8661 和方向 mAP 0.9065；LLM 编译分别给出 0.8588 和 0.9135。

sents.en: Compilation therefore improves direction ranking by 0.70 percentage points while trading off DE ranking and a small amount of continuous error.
sents.zh: 因此，编译以牺牲 DE 排名和少量连续误差为代价，将方向排名提升了 0.70 个百分点。

sents.zh: 这两个知识视图在来源体量上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation cohort contains 24 drugs, 72 conditions, and 966 questions; the validation cohort contains six drugs and 225 questions. Each question is paired with its condition’s evidence, a supported/contradicted/insufficient label, and acceptable proof bundles constructed from source rules. References define 561 answerable and 405 insufficient-evidence questions. For an answerable question, joint correctness requires the correct label, at least one complete acceptable proof, and citations drawn from the supplied evidence. Other responses receive zero. Success on an insufficient-evidence question requires a valid output with an explicit insufficient-evidence judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 评估队列包含24种药物、72种病症和966个问题；验证队列包含6种药物和225个问题。 每个问题都配有其对应病症的证据、一个支持/矛盾/证据不足的标签，以及基于源规则构建的可接受证明束。 参考答案定义了561个可回答问题和405个证据不足问题。 对于可回答的问题，联合正确性要求标签正确、至少包含一个完整且可接受的证明，并且引用来自所提供的证据。 其他回答得分为零。 证据不足问题的成功需要输出有效结果，并明确作出证据不足的判断。

sents.zh: 评估队列包含24种药物、72种病症和966个问题；验证队列包含6种药物和225个问题。

sents.en: References define 561 answerable and 405 insufficient-evidence questions.
sents.zh: 参考答案定义了561个可回答问题和405个证据不足问题。

sents.en: For an answerable question, joint correctness requires the correct label, at least one complete acceptable proof, and citations drawn from the supplied evidence.
sents.zh: 对于可回答的问题，联合正确性要求标签正确、至少包含一个完整且可接受的证明，并且引用来自所提供的证据。

sents.en: Other responses receive zero.
sents.zh: 其他回答得分为零。

sents.en: Success on an insufficient-evidence question requires a valid output with an explicit insufficient-evidence judgment.
sents.zh: 证据不足问题的成功需要输出有效结果，并明确作出证据不足的判断。

paragraphs.en: The answerable questions comprise 240 control-detection questions, 138 target-action scope questions, 126 background-path questions, and 57 source-statement questions. Across the 966 questions, there are 487 distinct question strings and 556 question-type/argument combinations; 126 questions share a string with the validation set. Question templates are reused with condition-specific evidence. The source rules also provide a deterministic comparator ( Table 16 ). The benchmark evaluates structured judgments and cited proofs, and the agent supplies accompanying natural-language rationales.
paragraphs.zh: 可回答的问题包括240道控制检测题、138道目标动作范围题、126道背景路径题以及57道来源陈述题。 在这966道问题中，共有487个不同的问题字符串和556种问题类型/参数组合；有126道问题与验证集共享相同的字符串。 问题模板在特定条件的证据下被重复使用。 这些来源规则还提供了一个确定性比较器（表16）。 该基准评测结构化判断和引用证明，智能体还会提供配套的自然语言理由说明。

paragraphs.en: The explanation procedure uses the DeepSeek Flash API ( deepseek-flash ) for source analysis, question answering, and localized review. Review feedback comprises source-scope, path, and formatting diagnostics. Error analysis on the evaluation panel informed refinement of the correction procedure. Reported scores evaluate the final pipeline; reference answers were not supplied to runtime correction.
paragraphs.zh: 解释流程使用 DeepSeek Flash API（deepseek-flash）进行源分析、问答和局部审查。 审查反馈包含源范围、路径和格式方面的诊断信息。 评估面板上的错误分析为修正流程的改进提供了依据。 报告的分数评估的是最终流水线；参考答案未提供给运行时修正环节。

paragraphs.en: A route is eligible when its endpoints, source records, and sign relationships satisfy the path criteria. Known edge signs are composed directly. Unknown signs are assigned jointly across paths so that a shared edge has one value within each completion. These alternative assignments distinguish conclusions that hold for every permitted sign from those that depend on an unresolved interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 当一条路径的端点、源记录和符号关系满足路径条件时，该路径即为合格的。 已知的边符号直接参与组合。 未知符号在各路径之间进行联合分配，使得共享边在每次补全中只有一个取值。 这些可替代的分配方式区分了那些对每种允许符号都成立的结论，与那些依赖于未解决交互的结论。

paragraphs.en: The language model selects and ranks candidate paths. If eligibility review leads to a correction, the included paths are ordered by length and source identifier; otherwise the model’s ordering is retained. Among the 72 evaluation conditions, 63 contain eligible reference paths. On these 63 conditions, valid path@3, precision@3, and recall@3 are each 1.000. Proposition scoring includes all 72 conditions, including the nine with no eligible reference path.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型选择并排序候选路径。 若资格性审查导致修正，则所纳入的路径按长度和来源标识符排序；否则保留模型的排序。 在72个评估条件中，有63个包含符合条件的参考路径。 在这63个条件上，valid path@3、precision@3 和 recall@3 均为1.000。 命题评分涵盖全部72个条件，包括其中九个没有符合条件的参考路径的条件。

paragraphs.en: The observation-state task comprises 20 measurement–target records spanning 12 drugs and 13 unique conditions. Each record is presented before measurement, after measurement, and after withdrawal, producing 480 questions: 120 answerable and 360 insufficient. Gene identities and numerical predicates are matched to their source records, and the language model supplies a judgment, citation, and explanation. Withdrawal removes a record from the active evidence while retaining its history. The agent correctly answers all 120 answerable questions with complete proof and makes the correct insufficient-evidence judgment on all 360 insufficient questions.
paragraphs.zh: 观测状态任务包含 20 条测量—目标记录，涵盖 12 种药物和 13 种不同条件。 每条记录都会在测量前、测量后和撤药后呈现，共产生 480 个问题：120 个可回答，360 个证据不足。 基因身份和数值谓词与其来源记录相匹配，语言模型则给出判断、引用和解释。 撤药会将一条记录从有效证据中移除，同时保留其历史。 智能体对所有 120 个可回答的问题给出完整证明的正确答案，并对所有 360 个证据不足的问题作出正确的证据不足判断。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 presents Trichostatin A (TSA) in two experiments. The Explain experiment uses K562 at 24 hours with pooled doses. Its evidence includes functional HDAC1 inhibition, a binding record with an unspecified action sign, and an HDAC1 RNA detection fraction of 0.1530 in vehicle controls. Two background routes connect TSA to CYP24A1 through HDAC1: TSA–HDAC1–TP53–CYP24A1 has net sign + 1 +1 , and TSA–HDAC1–AR–ESR1–CYP24A1 has net sign − 1 -1 , including the inhibitory drug–target edge. These source-linked routes provide candidate mechanisms for the condition.
paragraphs.zh: 图5在两个实验中呈现了曲古抑菌素A（TSA）。 Explain 实验使用 K562 细胞、24 小时处理时间以及汇总剂量。 其证据包括对 HDAC1 的功能性抑制、一条作用符号未指定的结合记录，以及溶媒对照中 0.1530 的 HDAC1 RNA 检测比例。 两条经来源链接的背景通路通过 HDAC1 将 TSA 与 CYP24A1 相连：TSA–HDAC1–TP53–CYP24A1 的净符号为 +1，TSA–HDAC1–AR–ESR1–CYP24A1 的净符号为 −1，其中包含抑制性的药物–靶点边。 这些经来源链接的通路为该条件提供了候选机制。

paragraphs.en: Five-fold cross-fitting over the 54 support drugs produces parent residuals for updater training. Each outer fold refits the 96-dimensional knowledge projection, normalization, atlas representation, continuous MLP, and classification heads without that fold’s drug identities. Each MLP also uses internal whole-fold atlas masking. Cross-fitted predictions use three random seeds. The parent architecture and its 25-epoch schedule remain fixed. Nineteen validation drugs select updater settings before test evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 对54种支持药物进行五折交叉拟合，生成用于更新器训练的父残差。 每个外层折在不使用该折药物身份的情况下，重新拟合96维知识投影、归一化、图谱表示、连续MLP以及分类头。 每个MLP还使用内部整折图谱掩码。 交叉拟合预测使用三个随机种子。 父架构及其25轮训练计划保持固定。 在测试评估之前，由19种验证药物来选择更新器设置。

paragraphs.en: Each of three test partitions assigns one hidden cell line to each test drug identity; the assignment can differ across drugs. Observations come from the other two cell lines, with target conditions and their canonical aliases excluded from acquisition. Each measured source condition supplies a 2,000-gene response vector and 2,931-gene DE/DIR labels. Budgets count distinct source conditions: 112 observations cover one source cell line for each canonical drug, and 224 cover both. Each source condition can be selected once, up to the observation budget.
paragraphs.zh: 三个测试划分中的每一个都为每种测试药物标识分配一个隐藏细胞系；不同药物之间的分配可以不同。 观测数据来自另外两个细胞系，目标条件及其规范别名均从采集中排除。 每个被测量的源条件提供一个 2,000 基因的响应向量以及 2,931 基因的 DE/DIR 标签。 预算按不同的源条件计数：112 个观测覆盖每种规范药物的一个源细胞系，224 个覆盖两个。 每个源条件最多可被选择一次，不超过观测预算。

paragraphs.en: The Update experiment scores the shared condition predictor’s continuous and classification heads before cell generation. The three target-cell partitions contain 19,311, 18,336, and 18,711 sampled DE queries, respectively, on the 2,000-gene panel. Budgets of 12, 24, and 48 follow fixed numerical acquisition schedules; budgets of 112 and 224 supply one or two source contexts per identity. At every budget, updated and initial predictions are paired on the same hidden targets. Acquisition schedules are held constant to measure the contribution of prediction updating under cross-cell observations.
paragraphs.zh: Update 实验在细胞生成之前对共享条件预测器的连续输出头和分类输出头进行评分。 在 2,000 基因面板上，三个靶细胞分区分别包含 19,311、18,336 和 18,711 个采样的 DE 查询。 预算 12、24 和 48 遵循固定的数值获取计划；预算 112 和 224 为每个身份提供一或两个源上下文。 在每个预算下，更新后的预测与初始预测都在相同的隐藏目标上进行配对。 获取计划保持不变，以衡量在跨细胞观测下预测更新的贡献。

paragraphs.en: This task asks whether observing a drug response in one cell context improves prediction in an unobserved context. Each partition assigns a hidden cell context to each drug, and measurements come from its other contexts. A measurement reveals the source population at 24 hours, including 10, 100, 1,000, and 10,000 nM doses. We evaluate no observations, 48 observed conditions, and one source context per drug. Source selections are fixed before adaptation; target responses are used for evaluation. Scores average the three partitions, pairing each method’s adapted and unadapted predictions on the same hidden targets.

paragraphs.en: STATE updates its transition network with the energy distribution loss; PRnet updates its prediction network with Gaussian negative log-likelihood. chemCPA retains alternating reconstruction, dose-response, and adversarial optimization. PerturbNet updates its conditional flow with negative log-likelihood while holding scVI and chemical representations fixed. CMonge updates the conditional transport map with transport fitting and the Monge-gap penalty while keeping its autoencoder fixed. BioLORD updates the shared decoder and attribute networks together with nuisance codes for newly observed cells; existing cell codes remain fixed. STATE uses eight sets of 128 cells per update. CMonge uses sets of 128 cells from a single condition; the other models use mixed-condition batches of 128 cells. Optimization uses seed 42; generation uses condition- and dose-specific random streams derived from seed 42.
paragraphs.zh: STATE 使用能量分布损失更新其转移网络；PRnet 使用高斯负对数似然更新其预测网络。chemCPA 保留交替进行的重建、剂量-响应和对抗优化。 PerturbNet 使用负对数似然更新其条件流，同时固定 scVI 和化学表示。 CMonge 在保持其自编码器固定的同时，使用传输拟合和 Monge 间隙惩罚更新条件传输映射。 BioLORD 将共享解码器和属性网络与新观测细胞的滋扰编码一起更新；已有的细胞编码保持固定。 STATE 每次更新使用八组各 128 个细胞。 CMonge 使用来自单一条件的 128 个细胞组；其他模型使用 128 个细胞的混合条件批次。 优化使用种子 42；生成使用由种子 42 派生的针对条件和剂量的随机流。

paragraphs.en: CellCanon retains its condition-head readouts throughout observation feedback, with a 2,000-gene continuous source response and 2,931-gene source DE/DIR labels. Fine-tuning uses the observed single-cell expression in the 2,000-gene panel. All reported classification scores use the sampled 2,000-gene endpoint. Joint scores combine DE and direction into unchanged/up/down as in Appendix D ; each metric is computed within a partition and then averaged across the three partitions. paragraphs.en: With support DE/DIR label supervision for these genes, the independent classification heads achieve AUPRC of 0.7674/0.9212 and Macro-F1 of 0.7908/0.8535 on 24,630 DE queries and 3,777 true-DE direction queries. Their continuous response targets are absent from the main regression loss. For expression generation, an auxiliary dose-response model is fitted to their continuous support responses ( Section B.4 ); the generated Extra931 responses have logFC Pearson 0.5344 and Δ \Delta -Pearson of 0.2583 over 339 conditions. This separates classification with label supervision from continuous generation with response supervision. The combined 2,931-gene panel contains 80,228 sampled queries and 12,428 DE positives.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些基因的 DE/DIR 标签监督支持下，独立分类头在 24,630 个 DE 查询和 3,777 个真实 DE 方向查询上分别取得 0.7674/0.9212 的 AUPRC 和 0.7908/0.8535 的 Macro-F1。 它们的连续响应目标不包含在主回归损失中。 对于表达量生成，一个辅助的剂量-响应模型被拟合到它们的连续支持响应上（见 B.4 节）；生成的 Extra931 响应在 339 个条件下取得 0.5344 的 logFC Pearson 相关系数和 0.2583 的 Δ \Delta-Pearson 相关系数。 这将带有标签监督的分类与带有响应监督的连续生成区分开来。 合并后的 2,931 基因面板包含 80,228 个采样查询和 12,428 个 DE 正样本。

paragraphs.en: Removing the additional 931 genes from atlas response values, classification supervision, and output preserves core DE AP within 0.0005 of the complete model, while reducing direction Macro-F1 by 0.0067. Retraining only core heads with the original frontend changes scores little. The core-only atlas also changes projection size and initialization: frontend-plus-continuous parameters fall from 939,027 to 819,859 per seed. Consequently this comparison measures the combined input-panel and architecture change. External knowledge may still mention genes outside the core panel, and DE labels retain their original multiple-testing definition.
paragraphs.zh: 从图谱响应值、分类监督和输出中移除额外的 931 个基因后，核心 DE AP 与完整模型相差不超过 0.0005，而方向 Macro-F1 降低了 0.0067。 仅使用原始前端重新训练核心头时，分数变化很小。 仅核心的图谱还改变了投影大小和初始化：每个种子的前端加连续参数从 939,027 降至 819,859。 因此，这一比较衡量的是输入基因面板与架构变化的综合影响。 外部知识仍可能提及核心基因面板之外的基因，且 DE 标签保留其原始的多重检验定义。
